title: I dont trust Claude to touch my projects anymore
author: Fit-Gas-5760
selftext:
I have some very niche projects that require a high degree of complexity for development.

Many times Claude was hindering my progress, forcing me to hold his hand and show him how to do things after I had to read the codebase myself (how absurd to do that in plan 2026 /s).

Since Nano, everything has worked seamlessly, my codebase is much cleaner and more efficient, and I've never needed to steer development for more than 2 messages per task.

The insecurity I had before about letting less capable models handle my projects, I feel that now with Claude. Even Fable 5.2 falls into that category of "less capable models". What a time to live in.
